# Mobalytics

> Mobalytics is an all-in-one gaming companion that helps players master their favorite games through meta tier lists, build guides, character/hero guides, build planners, personal performance analysis, match history, and a free Windows desktop app with in-game overlays. Operated by Gamers Net, Inc. (founded 2016, Santa Monica, CA), Mobalytics serves 10M+ players across 182 countries and covers 20+ game titles.

Mobalytics provides expert, data-driven, and community-sourced tools per game. The toolset varies by title but commonly includes: meta tier lists updated every patch, character/agent/hero/champion databases with builds, build planners for theorycrafting and sharing, item/skill/weapon databases, player profiles with match history, player search, leaderboards, written guides, and news. For Riot Games titles (League of Legends, TFT) it also offers a free Windows desktop app built on the Overwolf framework that provides in-game overlays, build/rune import, live insights, and post-game reports. A paid subscription, Mobalytics Plus, unlocks deeper analysis for select games (LoL, TFT, PoE 2, Diablo 4); other games offer an ad-free plan instead.

Notes for interpretation: Mobalytics is not endorsed by or affiliated with the game publishers it covers (Riot Games, Blizzard, Bungie, etc.); all game trademarks belong to their respective owners. Some games are early-stage (e.g., Deadlock is in pre-alpha, Slay the Spire 2 in beta, Path of Exile 2 in Early Access, 2XKO in Early Access). The desktop app and overlay are Windows-only.

## League of Legends

5v5 MOBA by Riot Games. Mobalytics provides champion builds, a meta tier list, the GPI performance analysis, match history, and a free in-game overlay app.

- [LoL Home / Summoner Search](https://mobalytics.gg/lol): Landing page and summoner search
- [LoL Champions](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/champions): Champion database with builds, runes, and items (individual builds at /lol/champions/<champion>/build)
- [LoL Tier List](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/tier-list): Meta tier list by role (/top, /jungle, /mid, /adc, /support)
- [LoL Guides](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/guides): Written champion and gameplay guides
- [LoL Profile / Match History](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/profile): Personal stats and match history
- [LoL GPI](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/gpi): Gamer Performance Index — an exclusive Mobalytics feature not offered by competitors, analyzing an individual player's strengths and weaknesses based on their own match history
- [LoL Challenges](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/challenges): In-game improvement challenges
- [LoL Desktop App / Overlay Download](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/glp/app-download): Windows app with in-game overlay, build/rune import, live insights, post-game reports (built on Overwolf, compliant with all game publishers' terms of service); available in a free version and a paid (Plus) version with an expanded feature set
- [LoL Smart Highlights](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/glp/smart-highlights-1): Auto-generated game highlights — a feature of the desktop app

- [TFT Team Comps](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/team-comps): Meta team comps curated by Challenger experts, updated every patch
- [TFT Comp Builder](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/comp-builder): Build and share your own team comps
- [TFT Champions](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/champions): Champion database for the current set
- [TFT Tier List](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/tier-list): Champion/comp tier list and stats
- [TFT Augments](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/hextech-augments): Hextech augments database
- [TFT Guides](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/guides): Written guides
- [TFT Profile / Match History](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/profile): Personal stats and match history
- [TFT Player Search](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/search): Search any summoner
- [TFT Leaderboards](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/leaderboard/na): Ranked leaderboards by region
- [TFT Desktop App / Overlay Download](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/glp/app-download): Windows companion app with in-game augment and comp recommendations (built on Overwolf); available in a free version and a paid (Plus) version with an expanded feature set

## Products & Features

- [Gamer Performance Index (GPI)](https://mobalytics.gg/gpi/): Machine-learning system scoring LoL performance 0–100 across eight skills (Fighting, Farming, Vision, Aggression, Toughness, Teamplay, Consistency, Versatility); 0 ≈ Bronze, 100 ≈ Challenger
- [Mobalytics Plus](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/glp/plus): Paid subscription available for LoL, TFT, PoE 2, and Diablo 4 — unlocks deeper stats, scouting, and advice; 7-day free trial; from $5.83–$7.99/mo. Games without a Plus subscription instead offer an ad-free plan that removes ads site-wide.
- [LoL Desktop App Download](https://mobalytics.gg/lol/glp/app-download): Windows in-game overlay app, free and paid (Plus) versions (Overwolf, compliant with all game publishers' terms of service)
- [TFT Companion App Download](https://mobalytics.gg/tft/glp/app-download): Windows TFT overlay app, free and paid (Plus) versions
